query: What are the common advantage attributes of airlines whose overall rating is high?

per_column.name: is_high_rating
per_column.rationale: This is a binary flag on Overall Rating, i.e. the segmentation/outcome condition of the query. Overall rating is what competitive advantage is meant to explain; it is not an aspect OF competitive advantage. It is a whole-outcome indicator, not a part-of the concept.

per_column.name: primary_advantage
per_column.rationale: Although its category values (Seat Comfort, Staff Service, Value For Money, Food & Beverages, Inflight Entertainment) name genuine facets, this column collapses the whole concept into a single winner-take-all label. It restates 'the competitive advantage' as one categorical rather than being one aspect OF it, and it does not provide separate non-overlapping facet dimensions.

per_column.name: advantage_strength
per_column.rationale: Conceptually a magnitude/overall-intensity measure of the whole advantage, not a constitutive aspect. It also is degenerate (constant 0 across all 8100 rows), carrying no decompositional information about any facet.

per_column.name: is_exceptional_service
per_column.rationale: This targets the staff-service dimension, which is a genuine part-of / aspect of an airline's competitive advantage. It is a weak realization (binary threshold rather than a clean facet dimension) and overlaps with the 'Staff Service' value in primary_advantage, but it does map to a real constitutive facet.

per_column.name: attribute_count_high
per_column.rationale: A count of how many attributes are rated high is an aggregate summary of the whole advantage profile (its breadth/magnitude), not a specific aspect OF the concept. It sums across facets rather than carving one out.

judge.rationale: This set does not realize a faceted MECE decomposition of 'airline_competitive_advantage'. The constitutive facets of the concept are the competitive dimensions already present as ratings (Seat Comfort, Staff Service, Food & Beverages, Inflight Entertainment, Value For Money); a proper decomposition would express each as its own non-overlapping facet column. Instead: is_high_rating is the outcome/segmentation flag (overall rating), advantage_strength and attribute_count_high are whole-concept magnitude/breadth summaries (one degenerate constant), and primary_advantage collapses the concept into a single winner-take-all label. Only is_exceptional_service weakly isolates one true facet (service). Mutual exclusivity is low because the advantage-related columns (primary_advantage, is_exceptional_service, attribute_count_high) all re-derive from the same underlying attribute ratings and overlap on 'service'. Exhaustiveness is very low because the concept's main constitutive aspects are not each represented as facets.
